settings.title: Settings

research.consent_body: AutoApply can collect anonymized data about your job search experience to help researchers study and improve the hiring market. No personal information is ever included. You can opt out at any time in Settings.

builder.title: Search builder
builder.target_company: A company careers page (paste its link)
builder.opened: Opened in your browser — kept in your recent searches.
builder.no_link: This surface has no link to open — paste the search bar text yourself.
builder.nothing_built: Nothing was built — nothing to copy, open or keep.

note.site_no_typed: {surface} has no way to limit a typed search to one site, so no search text or link was written — one without the site limit would be a different search.
note.any_of_no_typed: {surface} has no way to say 'any of these' in its search bar, so no search text or link was written.
note.exclude_no_typed: {surface} has no way to exclude words in its search bar, so no search text or link was written.
note.intitle_no_typed: {surface} has no title filter in its search bar, so no search text or link was written.
note.phrase_no_quotes: {surface} has no exact-phrase quoting; your phrase was written without quotes.
note.length: That search is {count} words; {surface} is reported to stop reading after {limit}{source}. Nothing was written — cutting it down would not be the search you asked for.
note.template_missing: {surface} has no link form called '{template}'. Choices: {choices}.
note.phrase_url_unverified: {surface} has no exact-phrase quoting AA can verify, so your words went into the link without quotes.
note.options_empty: Settings without any search terms make no link, so they were not applied.
note.empty: Nothing to build yet — add at least one term.
note.location_unsupported: {surface} has no place for a location, so '{location}' was left out of the search. Add the place to your search words, or pick a surface that takes a location.
note.option_missing: {surface} has no '{option}' setting, so it was left out.
note.option_invalid_value: '{value}' is not a value {surface}'s '{option}' setting can carry.
note.option_invalid_choice: '{value}' is not a choice for {label}. Choices: {choices}.
note.option_url_only_with_note: {label} cannot be typed into {surface}'s search bar — the link carries it. {note}
note.option_url_only: {label} cannot be typed into {surface}'s search bar — the link carries it.
note.unexpressible: {surface} has no way to carry {unexpressible}, so no search text or link was written — one without it would be a different search.
note.no_typed_form: {surface} has no typed search form AA can write for you — the link below is the way to use it.
note.company_unknown_platform: That address is not on a hiring platform AA knows, so no search was built.

platform.unverified: Unverified: the search mechanism is documented, but how much of this platform it reaches is not yet known. Open the link yourself and check that results come from the platform; the user guide shows how to report the outcome.
platform.third_party: Reported by others; AA has not checked it.

status.opened: Link opened in your browser; the search was kept.
status.recent_loaded: Showing a remembered search. Edit the fields to build a new one.
status.recent_unavailable: That search used a site that is not available here.

platform.not_eligible: Not yet verified for automated search — the user guide's verification checklist shows how to verify it by hand.

pick.unverified_count: {count} more platforms are not yet verified for automated search (type v to list them).
pick.none_eligible: No hiring platforms are verified for automated search yet — a standard search will run.
pick.unavailable: The platform list could not be loaded — a standard search will run.

preview.mode_generic: Standard search — every enabled engine, for each title and location:
